description: Drone Technician is responsible for assembling, maintaining, repairing, and testing unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to ensure optimal performance and safety. He is responsible for diagnosing technical issues, upgrading firmware, calibrating sensors and controls, and ensuring compliance with aviation regulations. They often work closely with drone operators and engineers to support flight operations, conduct inspections, and provide technical expertise.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Follow Drone Regulations, Safety and Flight Planning Procedures.
Identify Drone Mechanical Components and Perform Basic Assembly.
Perform SMD Component Identification and PCB Soldering.
Measure Electrical Parameters of Drone Hardware.
Manage Drone Battery Systems and Charging.
Test and Control BLDC Motors and Drivers.
Configure RF Communication, GPS and Telemetry Systems.
Configure and Test Flight Controller Board and ESC.
Perform Drone Camera, Gimbal Operation and Applications.
Perform Drone Software Configuration and Debugging.
Perform Drone Inspection, Servicing and Troubleshooting.
